arStrings.szText: "We need to find the Hand of Akarat."
That creature made a mess of things. You’ll have to climb your way up, and I’ll only slow you down.
Lorath is confident, in commander mode. He is telling the Player to climb up some wreckage in the ship to reach the top deck, where the Hand of Akarat (servant of Mephisto) is.
Go! I’ll help the crew keep the ship afloat. Otherwise, it won’t matter if we find that bastard.
